caption: The video captures a fire burning against a black night sky, with a bright yellow-white flame mass anchored along the bottom, mostly left of center. Above this base, a taller, dimmer orange plume rises and continuously deforms, cycling between a rightward-curving hook and a vertical column with a curling top. The plume's upper part repeatedly breaks into detached wisps that drift upward and fade while the bright base stays connected below. The bottom core expands and contracts, shifting its outline from broad rounded bulges to narrower columns. Small glowing embers scatter across the dark background. The plume's tip swings from upper-right to upper-center and back toward a rightward hook. The hook forms, loosens into diffuse orange smoke, and re-forms while the base flame remains low in the frame.
